runnability.evidence: One command regenerates video, metrics, labels, policy card, stress eval, and judge artifacts.

mujoco_depth.evidence: Uses the official FF Master humanoid with sensors, actuators, free bodies, task zones, lights, cameras, and rendered telemetry.

task_design.evidence: Long-horizon service workflow: hazard sorting, beacon inspection, medkit retrieval, delivery, and labeled dataset export.

control.evidence: Logs raw-vs-corrected visual-servo error, residual correction norms, contact-balance scores, slip observer, and disturbance recovery.

dexterous_manipulation.evidence: Coordinated whole-body arm and wrist package handling with contact tracking; honest limitation is no independent finger DOF in FF Master.

engineering_quality.evidence: Deterministic script, structured JSON/CSV artifacts, UUID consistency, fixed-seed stress replay, and local validator.

presentation.evidence: Generated video has camera motion and concise overlays for phase, residual error, contact tracks, confidence, and success metrics.

innovation.evidence: Combines humanoid route execution, safety triage, residual recovery, and dataset generation in a compact reproducible benchmark.

stress_eval_summary.description: Fixed-seed perturbation replay of package pose offset, slip impulse, and mass delta.
